definition: Further training a pre-trained model on a narrower dataset to specialise its behaviour.
commonMisconception: Fine-tuning is the same as prompting. It isn't — fine-tuning changes the model's weights; prompting only changes what's in the context window for one interaction.
relevance: Comes up when discussing why this course uses prompting and skills, not model training, to customise Claude's behaviour.

definition: A setting that influences how much variation appears in a model's generated responses.
